description: Unit tests for the NoopHeaderValidator class in the HTTP/2 adapter, testing header validation logic including pseudo-headers, header values, and special cases.

classes.name: NoopHeaderValidator
classes.description: A header validator class that performs no validation, used for testing header handling logic.

methods.name: ValidateSingleHeader
methods.description: Validates a single header line, always returns HEADER_OK in this no-op implementation.

methods.name: SetMaxFieldSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed size for header fields.

methods.name: StartHeaderBlock
methods.description: Begins validation of a new header block.

methods.name: FinishHeaderBlock
methods.description: Completes validation of a header block, optionally with a specific header type.

methods.name: status_header
methods.description: Returns the value of the :status pseudo-header if present.

methods.name: content_length
methods.description: Returns the parsed content-length value if valid.

methods.name: SetAllowExtendedConnect
methods.description: Allows extended validation for CONNECT method pseudo-headers.
